---
name: Share anonymized timeline data
about: Help calibrate the model with real durations. Ranges are fine. Never include confidential information.
title: "Timeline data: [industry or org size]"
labels: data
---

Thank you for helping make the Compliance Relay more realistic. Share ranges, not exact figures, and nothing that identifies your organization, products or customers.

**Organization size (employees):** [under 100 / 100–1,000 / 1,000–10,000 / over 10,000]
**Region:** [EU / US / other]
**Regulation:** [for example, EU CRA, NIS2, DORA]

**Handoffs:** how many teams did the requirement pass through before engineering received work?
**Time to backlog:** roughly how many weeks from publication or a policy decision to an engineering backlog item?
**Planning cadence:** [quarterly / half-yearly / annual]. Can compliance work enter mid-cycle? [yes / no]
**Capacity:** roughly what share of team time goes to on-call, incident response and keeping existing products running?
**Blocked periods:** roughly how many weeks a year are lost to freezes, release crunches or audit seasons?
**Earliest checkpoint:** how far ahead of the legal deadline is your internal readiness or audit checkpoint?
**Upstream lag:** time from an upstream security fix to your shipped release, on your last three security fixes (days or weeks).

**Anything the model is missing?**
